title: Find Gmail Customers Using LIKE
description:
Write a query to return all customers whose `email` ends with `'@gmail.com'`. Return `id`, `name`, and `email`.

**Table: customers**

| Column | Type |
|--------|------|
| id | INT |
| name | VARCHAR |
| email | VARCHAR |
| city | VARCHAR |
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE customers (id INT, name VARCHAR, email VARCHAR, city VARCHAR); INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1, 'Alice Johnson', 'alice@gmail.com', 'New York'), (2, 'Bob Smith', 'bob@yahoo.com', 'Chicago'), (3, 'Carol Davis', 'carol@gmail.com', 'Los Angeles'), (4, 'Diana Prince', 'diana@company.com', 'Houston'), (5, 'Evan Brown', 'evan@gmail.com', 'Phoenix'), (6, 'Frank Wilson', 'frank@hotmail.com', 'Seattle'), (7, 'Grace Lee', 'grace@gmail.com', 'Boston');
solution_sql: SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE email LIKE '%@gmail.com'

test_cases.description: Returns 4 customers with gmail.com email addresses

hints: The `%` wildcard in `LIKE` matches **zero or more** characters. `'%@gmail.com'` matches anything ending with '@gmail.com'.
Use `'%gmail%'` if you want to match gmail anywhere in the string, or `'%@gmail.com'` to anchor to the end.
explanation: `LIKE '%@gmail.com'` uses `%` to match any prefix before the literal `@gmail.com`, returning 4 customers: Alice, Carol, Evan, and Grace.
